name: zai
description: GLM chat completions, web search, page reading, OCR, images, video and transcription on Z.ai's standard API
long_description: Bring a Z.ai Standard API Key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token to Z.ai's international standard API (api.z.ai/api/paas/v4). Saving, replacing or testing the key counts the tokens of a two-character message with POST /tokenizer, which runs no generation. A Sprite can then call the OpenAI-compatible chat completions route with GLM models, count tokens, search the web, read a web page, parse document layouts with GLM-OCR, generate images and videos, poll asynchronous results and transcribe audio. These calls use your Z.ai balance or usage bundles, not GLM Coding Plan quota. The Coding Plan and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, agents, file uploads, the China host open.bigmodel.cn, and key, billing and account management are not forwarded.

notes: Streaming sends Server-Sent Events, so the first bytes arrive well inside the gateway's 120-second header deadline. Without `stream`, keep `max_tokens` modest or a long reply may time out.

messages.400: Z.ai rejected the request (%{status}); check error.code and error.message, for example 1211 for an unknown model
messages.403: This Z.ai key has no permission for that API
messages.429: Z.ai rate limit, usage limit or balance reached; check error.code (1113 means the balance is empty, 1302 the rate limit)
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Z.ai; retry later

presentation.tagline: Call GLM models and Z.ai's search, OCR and media APIs from a Sprite without putting your Z.ai key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at z.ai, top up your balance at z.ai/manage-apikey/billing if needed, then open z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list and create a key under Standard API Key. GLM Coding Plan and Team Plan keys are meant for the Coding Plan endpoint, which this connector does not use.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key sends `POST /tokenizer` with a two-character message; it runs no generation, and Z.ai's pricing page lists no charge for it. Every other call uses your Z.ai balance or usage bundles at pay-as-you-go rates, never Coding Plan quota: chat and OCR are billed per token (GLM-5.3 is $1.4 input and $4.4 output per million tokens), web search costs $0.01 a search, GLM-Image $0.015 an image, CogVideoX-3 $0.2 a video and GLM-ASR $0.03 per million tokens.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /chat/completions`, `POST /tokenizer`, `POST /web_search`, `POST /reader`, `POST /layout_parsing`, `POST /images/generations`, `POST /async/images/generations`, `POST /videos/generations`, `GET /async-result/:id` and `POST /audio/transcriptions` on `api.z.ai/api/paas/v4` are forwarded. The Coding Plan endpoint (`/api/coding/paas/v4`), the Anthropic-compatible endpoint, agents and their file uploads, the China host `open.bigmodel.cn`, and key, billing and account management are not.

usage_notes: OpenAI SDKs work with `base_url` set to the connector's gateway URL; model ids are lower case, such as `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash` and `glm-4.7-flash` (free).

Errors are `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`, where `code` is Z.ai's business error code; a wrong key answers 401. A streaming call that fails mid-generation reports it in `finish_reason` instead.
Image generation with `POST /async/images/generations` and video generation return a task `id`; poll `GET /async-result/:id`.
